title: RandomUser User Structure
description: JSON Structure decomposition of the User entity returned by the Random User Generator API. Each top-level field maps to a logical concern (identity, contact, address, credentials, demographics, media, locale).

sections.name: Demographics
sections.purpose: Describe the simulated person's gender, age, and nationality.

sections.name: Identity
sections.purpose: Personal name and a nationality-appropriate identifier (SSN, NINO, etc.).

sections.name: Contact
sections.purpose: Channels by which the user can be reached.

sections.name: Address
sections.purpose: Street, city, state, postcode, geographic coordinates, and timezone.

sections.name: Credentials
sections.purpose: Account credentials and hashed-password variants (uuid, username, password, salt, md5, sha1, sha256).

sections.name: Membership
sections.purpose: When the user 'registered' for the synthetic system.

sections.name: Media
sections.purpose: Pre-generated portrait URLs at three resolutions.

cardinality: A `UserResponse` envelope contains 1..5000 User objects in `results` plus an `info` block describing the seed/page/version of the batch.
stability: Fields are stable across the v1.4 contract. Use the pinned-version endpoint `/api/1.4/` to lock the structure against future releases.
